source_caption:
Robert Pattinson played multiple versions of the same character in Mickey 17, creating subtle differences in voice, posture, and personality for each “iteration” to show how the character evolves despite being repeatedly replaced.

Mickey 17 (2025), directed by Bong Joon-ho, starring Robert Pattinson, Naomi Ackie, Mark Ruffalo. A darkly inventive sci-fi story about an expendable worker sent on dangerous missions, blending existential ideas with sharp humor and social commentary.

source_details.title: Mickey 17
source_details.synopsis: Mickey 17 is a 2025 science fiction black comedy film written, produced, and directed by Bong Joon Ho, based on the 2022 novel Mickey7 by Edward Ashton. The film stars Robert Pattinson in the title role, alongside Naomi Ackie, Steven Yeun, Patsy Ferran, Cameron Britton, Daniel Henshall, Stephen Park, Anamaria Vartolomei, Toni Collette, and Mark Ruffalo. Set in the year 2054, the plot follows a man who joins a space colony voyage as an "Expendable", a disposable worker who is cloned every time he dies.
